scope: Remove the source exclusion from the low-flag initialization as well as all subsequent source head/feature fits.
source_initializer: Refit original member1 clinical and dermoscopic ConvNeXt from ImageNet; source folds2/3/4 train, fold1 validation, fold0 unused. Same selected lr5e-5, seed, augmentation, bfloat16,16 epochs maximum, patience4. No new LR search.
lowflag: Then repeat original source heads, laststage, warmstage, source-only choice, multiscale, and 20 grouped local fits. Source AK maps to binary0/subtype0; KA to binary1/SCC-family; SCCIS separate subtype4.
source_thresholds: S uses pooled90%, MEL95%, SCC-family95% including retained KA, BCC90%, SCCIS90%. AK never enters SCCIS denominator.
external_training: Original external training manifests and group roles retained; endpoint-setting comparisons are downstream audits of these fitted decisions, not separate target-model retrainings.
amendment_to: protocol/PLAN.json: replaces the initially planned fixed low-flag warm-start checkpoint with its expanded-source refit; all other recipes retained.
